title: Cratylus's own branching and commit conventions
situation: General working conventions now ship as rulesets (Git flow as published, Conventional Commits, commit discipline); AGENTS.md keeps only cratylus's own. The operator renamed the integration branch dev to develop, as published Git flow names it, and keeps merging features into develop locally.
decision: The integration branch is develop. Feature branches branch from develop, are short-lived, and merge into develop locally without a pull request once the one check passes on the merged result. Release is a pull request from develop into main, and it is the operator's.
consequences: The general conventions are the installed rulesets', not restated here; AGENTS.md carries this one.
